{
  "categories": [
    {
      "name": "kernel",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Changes CScriptWitness internals without touching the kernel C API or boundary.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "CScriptWitness compiles into the kernel library but this change does not alter the kernel API or boundary."
    },
    {
      "name": "mempool",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Directly impacts memory consumption and DoS resilience of transactions held in memory.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.68,
      "reason_tag": "DoS protection",
      "rationale": "Mitigates a memory-exhaustion vector where crafted transactions with many small witness elements consume up to 28 bytes per weight unit while held in memory, dropping worst-case allocation to 1.6 bytes/WU according to the PR description. While it introduces a 50-70 ms per block validation tradeoff, resolving this memory amplification is of substantial, durable value for node stability under load."
    },
    {
      "name": "p2p",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches transaction witness representation rather than peer connection, wire transport, or message relay logic.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Changes to transaction data structures do not affect p2p message protocols or network-level transport."
    },
    {
      "name": "tests",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches test files only mechanically to adapt to the new encapsulated witness interface.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Edits to unit and functional tests are follow-up scripted-diff changes and do not modify test framework infrastructure."
    },
    {
      "name": "tools",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches tools mechanically to adapt to the new CScriptWitness interface.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Edits in tools follow mechanically from encapsulating direct stack access."
    },
    {
      "name": "utils",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Redesigns core serialization and witness storage primitives.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.62,
      "reason_tag": "DoS protection",
      "rationale": "Replaces the internal vector-of-vectors layout in CScriptWitness with a single serialized allocation parsed on the fly. This fundamentally improves memory safety and allocation efficiency for a shared primitive across the node."
    }
  ],
  "factors": {
    "security_stability": 2,
    "bug_severity": 1,
    "performance": 2,
    "user_value": 0,
    "leverage": 1
  }
}
